text:
olivia: noticed higher egress queueing from eu-west GPU pool, 95th p95 token latency creeping up 280ms -> 520ms in last 4m. dashboard: https://redwood.internal/dash/gpu-eu-west :thinking_face:
mohit: thanks — any cluster-level alerts? health-checks?
jiang: eu-west gpu-pool-3 shows 2/8 nodes in degraded state, kernel OOMs and network interface flaps reported in syslog. kube shows pod restarts.
ana: (typo) actually ana: OOMs look like a memory leak in the new batching worker image rolled 2h ago. Investigating.
nana: @olivia can we reduce weight to eu-west in GSLB while ana triages? we should avoid a full failover, prefer gradual steer.
olivia: agreed. thinking bandwidth-aware steer: shift 30% -> 10% over 90s, target ap-south and na-west. keep sticky sessions for dedicated tenants.
mohit: +1. I'll prepare a policy change: route_policy: gslb/bandwidth_aware with max_shift=20 per step 45s, prefer-region=[na-west,ap-south], fallback=eu-fallback
mohit: applying change now: `curl -X POST https://gslb-api.redwood/api/v1/policies/override -d '{"policy":"bandwidth_aware","steps":3,"step_delay_s":45,"weights":{"eu-west":10,"na-west":45,"ap-south":45}}'`
deploy-bot: config-change triggered by mohit at 1832105501, change id cfg-98321, will apply progressively.
sre-bot: monitor rule: alert if global 95th token latency >700ms for 5m or error-rate >1.5%
jiang: noticing some spike in inter-region egress cost estimate if we hit full 45/45 split; ballpark +12% for the hour if sustained. cost team FYI.
nana: ana here — I'm dumping logs from the new image to a debug pod and attaching core dump to the ticket INFRA-1219. suspect bump in in-memory cache retention.
mohit: step1 applied: eu-west -> 20, na-west 40, ap-south 40. latency already down at 120s after change: p95 eu-west 380ms, global p95 300ms.
olivia: nice. keep canary live for 10m. set threshold: if eu-west p95 drops under 300ms and node count stabilizes, we can do slow rollback of the image; else we continue steer.
jiang: node auto-replace kicked for 2 nodes, provisioning ETA ~6m — ephemeral capacity should help.
nana: core dump uploaded to INFRA-1219, linking replication steps. will open a hotfix PR to limit cache size if repro confirmed.
mohit: step2 in 45s will push eu-west to 10. monitoring checks in place.
sre-bot: alert suppressed: GSLB override in progress (cfg-98321). will resume alerts after 10m unless severity worsens.
olivia: cost note for finance: route change may add cross-region egress; try to keep steer minimal and revert as soon as safe. ping @jiang for hourly cost delta.
jiang: will post an estimate after next billing snapshot. current estimate +9% for the last 30m given observed traffic distribution.
mohit: step2 applied at 1832105586. eu-west=10, na-west=45, ap-south=45. no errors in rollout logs.
nana: memory pressure on the problematic pods is trending down after container restart; not fully validated.
olivia: if eu-west continues improving, plan is to ramp back to eu-west 30% within 30m and then to normal 60% after full verification.
mohit: ack. I'll keep the GSLB change in place and prepare an automated rollback if error-rate >1% for 5m.
sre-bot: condition triggered: global error-rate spiked to 1.2% at 1832105730 but subsided to 0.4% within 90s; no rollback.
nana: telemetry and heap profiles saved. I'll run the heap diff and open PR with a focused patch.
jiang: two replaced nodes healthy now, no network flaps reported. current cluster state 8/8 ready.
mohit: keeping the override for 20 more minutes. will then begin gradual restore.
olivia: thanks team. postmortem note: action items - (1) revert bad image or patch cache cap, (2) add GSLB bandwidth-aware policy to runbook with step templates, (3) add cost estimate toggle to avoid surprise egress. I'll start a short incident doc.
nana: adding logs and PR link to INFRA-1219.
mohit: rolling back weights starting at 1832105760: plan restore steps [30,45,25] over 2 steps.
deploy-bot: change cfg-98402 started by mohit at 1832105760.
sre-bot: incident cleared: p95 back to pre-incident levels in all regions at 1832105799. closing monitoring window.
olivia: great work. follow-ups in INFRA-1219 and runbook update ticket RUNBOOK-58. :tada:
